money_accounts_wallet_check.name: money_accounts_wallet_check
money_accounts_wallet_check.value: ("money_accounts"."wallet_type" is null and "money_accounts"."authorised" is null) or "money_accounts"."kind" = 'mobile'

note_lines_debit_check.name: note_lines_debit_check
note_lines_debit_check.value: ("note_lines"."tti" is null and "note_lines"."rebate" is null) or "note_lines"."purchased_qty" is not null

notes_debit_totals_check.name: notes_debit_totals_check
notes_debit_totals_check.value: "notes"."kind" = 'debit' or ("notes"."tti" is null and "notes"."rebate" is null)

opening_entries_bond_check.name: opening_entries_bond_check
opening_entries_bond_check.value: ("opening_entries"."bond_boe_no" is null and "opening_entries"."bond_qty" is null) or ("opening_entries"."bond_boe_no" is not null and "opening_entries"."bond_qty" is not null)

purchase_lines_duty_check.name: purchase_lines_duty_check
purchase_lines_duty_check.value: ("purchase_lines"."duty_av" is null and "purchase_lines"."duty_cd" is null) or ("purchase_lines"."duty_av" is not null and "purchase_lines"."duty_cd" is not null)

purchase_lines_foregone_check.name: purchase_lines_foregone_check
purchase_lines_foregone_check.value: "purchase_lines"."foregone_total" is null or "purchase_lines"."duty_av" is not null

purchases_boe_check.name: purchases_boe_check
purchases_boe_check.value: ("purchases"."boe_no" is null and "purchases"."boe_lc_no" is null) or ("purchases"."boe_no" is not null and "purchases"."boe_lc_no" is not null)

purchases_boe_bonded_check.name: purchases_boe_bonded_check
purchases_boe_bonded_check.value: "purchases"."boe_bonded" is null or "purchases"."boe_no" is not null

sales_export_check.name: sales_export_check
sales_export_check.value: ("sales"."export_deemed" is null and "sales"."export_lc_no" is null) or ("sales"."export_deemed" is not null and "sales"."export_lc_no" is not null)

stock_documents_branches_check.name: stock_documents_branches_check
stock_documents_branches_check.value: ("stock_documents"."kind" = 'transfer' and "stock_documents"."to_branch_id" is not null) or ("stock_documents"."kind" = 'damage' and "stock_documents"."to_branch_id" is null and "stock_documents"."reason" is not null)

vat_adjustments_sd_export_check.name: vat_adjustments_sd_export_check
vat_adjustments_sd_export_check.value: ("vat_adjustments"."sd_export" is null and "vat_adjustments"."kind" <> 'sdExport') or ("vat_adjustments"."sd_export" is not null and "vat_adjustments"."kind" = 'sdExport')

vat_returns_submitted_check.name: vat_returns_submitted_check
vat_returns_submitted_check.value: ("vat_returns"."status" = 'draft' and "vat_returns"."snapshot" is null and "vat_returns"."ack_no" is null) or ("vat_returns"."status" = 'submitted' and "vat_returns"."snapshot" is not null and "vat_returns"."ack_no" is not null and "vat_returns"."submission_date" is not null)
